title: CAT 2022 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Coordinate Geometry
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: Let ABCD be a parallelogram such that the coordinates of its three vertices A, B, C are (1, 1), (3, 4) and (-2, 8), respectively. Then, the coordinates of the vertex D are
questions.explain: In a parallelogram, the diagonals bisect each other, so the midpoint of AC is the same as the midpoint of BD. Midpoint of AC = $(\frac{1 + (-2)}{2}, \frac{1 + 8}{2}) = (-0.5, 4.5)$. Let coordinates of D be $(x, y)$. Midpoint of BD = $(\frac{3 + x}{2}, \frac{4 + y}{2})$. Equating them: $\frac{3+x}{2} = -0.5 \Rightarrow x = -4$, and $\frac{4+y}{2} = 4.5 \Rightarrow y = 5$. Thus, D is $(-4, 5)$.
